source_scope: Static local card-text/deck review, not engine execution or an observed match. Organizer card data is not redistributed.
recommended_caption: Entered-deck resource map, not a single-turn script. Evolution timing still applies; Froslass acts between turns. Existing friendly damage enables transfer before the attack. [7]
mechanics_qualifications: Poffin can search at most two Basics with 70 HP or less. Both depicted Basics have 70 HP.
Impidimp uses Rare Candy or the Morgrem evolution route; normal evolution and Rare Candy timing restrictions apply.
Punk Up triggers when Grimmsnarl ex is played from hand to evolve during the turn, and attaches at most five Basic Darkness from the deck to Marnie Pokémon.
Froslass acts during Checkup on Ability Pokémon on both sides except every Froslass.
The Froslass-to-Munkidori arrow represents friendly damage being available; it is not a same-turn Checkup action or a requirement that damage come from Froslass.
A Darkness-equipped Munkidori can transfer at most three damage counters from one friendly Pokémon to one opposing Pokémon once during the turn.
Transfer precedes Shadow Bullet because attacking ends the turn. Attack numbers are printed damage before applicable modifications.
The attachment footer is a strategic resource tradeoff, not a claim about the policy choices observed in games.
